question: International Army Games - 2021 was held in which of the following countries from 22 August to 4 September?
solution:
The correct answer is ** Russia**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** ** International Army Games 2021:**

 
• **Host Country:** Russia hosted the International Army Games 2021.
 
• **Dates:** The games were held from August 22 to September 4, 2021.
 
• **Participation:** Over 280 teams from 42 countries participated in the games.
 
• O
